title: The universal-test compatibility square for one pair of components
statement: For a pseudofunctor P to categories, descent data D1 and D2 along a family f of maps, a component family r from D1 to D2, and indices a,b, PairCompatibility r a b is the proposition that every test object mapping to the a and b charts over the base satisfies the descent-morphism square: P(g1)(r_a) followed by the transition of D2 equals the transition of D1 followed by P(g2)(r_b). This is exactly the (a,b) component of the comm field of a descent morphism. If it holds for every pair, homOfPairCompatibility is the real descent morphism with component family r. Its component equation is reflexivity.

source.place: limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR (3), first proof by Zariski gluing

proof.text: Define PairCompatibility as a Prop structure whose sole field is the universal-test commutativity square of Mathlib Pseudofunctor.DescentData.Hom at the fixed pair. The definition contains no choice or postponed data.

Construct homOfPairCompatibility with hom field r and comm field the comm projection of the supplied pair proof. Its component equation is reflexivity. All constructions and the equation are proved in Lean.
